nom: good light Luna Fast Acting Pimple Patches

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily-prone skin, whose other pimple patches typically slide off, reports these stayed on and worked well overnight.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive skin, dealing with mask-related irritation, found the patches soothing rather than irritating.

concerns.blemishes: Reports on efficacy are split: several reviewers, mostly rating 1-3 stars, say the patches did nothing at all across multiple tries on different blemishes, including no change in stubborn or forming pimples, while a much larger number describe pimples flattening, shrinking dramatically, or clearing entirely overnight, with many noting it works best only once a whitehead has fully surfaced rather than on early or forming pimples.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers report visibly reduced redness and swelling around treated blemishes by the next morning, often alongside the pimple itself shrinking.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer specifically notes the patches shrink stubborn pimples overnight without drying out her skin.

aspects.libelle: Very strong adhesion, stays on overnight
Doesn't stick well for a minority of users
Only effective once a whitehead has surfaced
Comes in two sizes for different blemishes
Thin and nearly invisible under makeup

extraits.texte: these are a big waste of money. there is no ingredient that is useful for TREATING your acne spot. it's basically a blister patch to absorb moisture but nothing more. I should have checked Ingredients before purchasing. there are better products than this out there.

ive been trying different patches, and these were on sale so i decided it was their turn. i rate my patches based on how well they stick, how much gunk they absorb, and how they look. 1- i find that these dont stick very well, ive had to reapply them a few times bc they fall off, especially in places where theres a lot of movement like by my lips. compared to other patches where they'll stay regardless of movement 2- i think ive used like 8 of them so far, and only 1 patch out of the 8 have gotten a good amount of gunk out. and i made sure to apply it on whiteheads 3- theyre pretty visible to me despite being transparent i'll give 2 stars because the price is decent, and that one patch that had finally absorbed everything did it nicely.
Works good on fully formed white head zits, does nothing to help stop a forming pimple from reaching that point.

This product really does it's job and does it well. It removed the gunk, inflammation and redness overnight. I've tried numerous patches and since I have oily prone skin they fall come off in my sleep. I'm glad to have found patches that stay on and do work their powers while I snooze!

Many times I read great reviews and am let down. That was not the case with these. I was looking for an alternative to the Goo Getter stickers by Zitsticka and I honestly see better results with these. They stay on and help to heal my acne quick. Even if I have a suspected zit and it hasn't formed yet, these stop the zit from doing so. If I have a huge whitehead, I keep one of these patches on overnight and in the morning it's flattened out. In about 1-2 days, the redness is gone and my skin is back on track. I also like the size of these patches because they're big enough. I'll often get little clusters of acne and one of these patches can fit over 2 bumps. I also think these are thinner than the Zitsticka ones. I would definitely give these a try if you are considering it!!
As a teacher, my sensitive skin and mask wearing have been an issues. I wear these to cut down on irritation and they are very soothing.
Makes those stubborn pimples much less noticeable overnight without drying out my skin!
